groups.label: Apps & products
groups.description: Small, focused products for families, readers, researchers and everyday decisions.

groups.label: Research software
groups.description: Packages and interactive tools that make distributional models, dependence and uncertainty easier to inspect.

groups.label: Games & experiments
groups.description: Playable systems and prototypes used to explore interaction, pacing and world-building.

groups.label: Writing & publications
groups.description: Research papers, public notes and slower investigations into data, modelling and AI-assisted work.

projects.title: Little Now
projects.description: Caregiver-led play for ages 1–5: one practical activity matched to the time, setup and interests available right now.

details.Built for: Caregivers who want a useful idea quickly, then want to put the phone away.
details.Current focus: Preparing the first App Store release and its public activity-sharing flow.

projects.title: Panels
projects.description: A private reading workspace for organising, opening and working through visual publications.

details.Access: The deployment is active but intentionally limited to approved accounts.

projects.title: Margin
projects.description: A calm, personal feed for discovering research and getting enough context to decide what deserves a closer read.

details.Built for: Researchers who want a quieter way to keep up with relevant work.
details.Access: The current deployment is a private beta for approved accounts.

projects.title: Panel Pilot
projects.description: A local-first comic reader prototype exploring comfortable navigation, library management and a native reading experience.

details.Current focus: Release-readiness, device behaviour and validating the core reading flow.
details.Availability: Pre-release work; no public download is currently offered.

projects.title: Household Cash
projects.description: A deliberately small shared view of household cash, designed around clarity rather than financial-dashboard complexity.

details.Availability: Internal tool; financial details and the deployment remain private.

projects.title: gamlss.longitudinal
projects.description: Tools for fitting longitudinal GAMLSS models with flexible margins and copula dependence.

details.Built for: Repeated-measures problems where changing scale, skewness, tails, quantiles or within-subject dependence matter.
details.Current focus: Documentation, examples and practical modelling workflows.

projects.title: Distribution Playground
projects.description: Interactive GAMLSS distributions, copula dependence, quantile comparison and longitudinal simulation in one R-backed workbench.

details.Built for: Researchers, students and collaborators who need distribution shape and dependence to be visible.
details.Current focus: Deepening worked examples, interpretation and export workflows.

projects.title: Starfall Company
projects.description: A touch-first science-fantasy tactics game about positioning, pressure and keeping a small company alive.

details.Current state: The core loop is playable as a local MVP.
details.Current focus: Combat feel, encounter pacing and a coherent route to a public build.

projects.title: Copula-based joint regression models for correlated data
projects.description: A bivariate comparison of copula-based, mixed-model and estimating-equation approaches for correlated regression.

details.Question: What can the different correlated-data strategies represent, and where do their trade-offs show up?
details.Availability: The preprint and reproducible code are public.

projects.title: Aydin's Workbench blog
projects.description: Reproducible notes on Australian public data, modelling questions and projects while they are still taking shape.

details.Approach: Keep the data, caveats and reasoning visible rather than presenting a polished conclusion too early.
details.Format: Short public drafts, updated as the analysis develops.

projects.title: LLM statistician review bench
projects.description: A proposed benchmark comparing LLM-generated statistical reviews with paper reviews and expert expectations.

details.Question: What do language models reliably catch, miss or overstate when reviewing applied statistical work?
details.Next step: Design a small, rubric-based benchmark before building any larger evaluation system.

latestPosts.title: A First Pass At Australian Dwelling Prices
latestPosts.theme: Housing, cost of living, ABS data
latestPosts.description: A small reproducible look at ABS dwelling values, state mean prices and the housing-policy questions they raise.

latestPosts.title: Are NDIS Participant Outcomes Changing?
latestPosts.description: A simpler look at national participant outcome levels and changes after plan reassessment.

latestPosts.title: Did Bulk Billing Changes Shift Access?
latestPosts.description: An early reproducible look at whether expanded GP bulk-billing incentives changed access patterns.
